venue: 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting, trial-in-progress poster TPS3176
data_cutoff: No therapeutic Phase 1/2a cohort data cutoff was reported in the ASCO trial-in-progress disclosure

reported_data.population: The planned trial enrolls adults with DLL3-expressing small cell lung cancer after standard therapy, but the ASCO presentation described the protocol while dosing continued in the first cohort and did not disclose a therapeutic cohort denominator.
reported_data.efficacy: No RECIST response, disease-control, progression, survival or therapeutic dosimetry result from the Phase 1/2a cohort was disclosed. Separate diagnostic-isotope imaging under a named-patient access program showed specific uptake in tumor lesions but was not a therapeutic efficacy dataset.
reported_data.safety: No Phase 1/2a adverse-event, serious-adverse-event or dose-limiting-toxicity counts were disclosed at this event.
reported_data.follow_up: No therapeutic patient follow-up duration was disclosed; initial clinical data remained expected later in 2026.

reported_data.population: The planned trial includes other DLL3-expressing neuroendocrine carcinomas, including extrapulmonary disease, but the ASCO presentation was a protocol poster and disclosed no target-specific therapeutic cohort denominator.
reported_data.efficacy: No indication-specific response, disease-control, progression or survival result was reported from the Phase 1/2a therapeutic study.
reported_data.safety: No indication-specific or pooled Phase 1/2a safety results were disclosed.
reported_data.follow_up: No therapeutic follow-up duration was disclosed at the event.

reported_data.population: The planned trial includes DLL3-expressing large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, but the ASCO presentation described study design and disclosed no target-specific therapeutic cohort denominator.
reported_data.efficacy: No LCNEC response, disease-control, progression or survival result was reported from the Phase 1/2a therapeutic study.
reported_data.safety: No LCNEC-specific or pooled Phase 1/2a safety results were disclosed.
reported_data.follow_up: No therapeutic follow-up duration was disclosed at the event.

competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: DLL3-directed therapy after platinum-based treatment in relapsed extensive-stage SCLC; modality, dose and development maturity differ from targeted alpha therapy.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: The randomized DeLLphi-304 study established a mature DLL3 efficacy benchmark, with median overall survival of 13.6 versus 8.3 months and median progression-free survival of 4.2 versus 3.2 months against chemotherapy. The MP0712 ASCO protocol poster supplied no therapeutic result that can be compared with this benchmark.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Cross-modality comparison between a DLL3 bispecific T-cell engager with randomized clinical evidence and an early targeted alpha therapy protocol without disclosed therapeutic outcomes.

competitor_comparisons.competitor: Obrixtamig in DLL3-positive extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma
competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: Heavily pretreated DLL3-positive extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma in a Phase 1 dose-escalation study.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: At doses of at least 90 micrograms per kilogram, obrixtamig reported a 27.9% objective response rate among 61 extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma patients and a 19.6% confirmed response rate in later step-up cohorts. MP0712 disclosed no therapeutic cohort result at ASCO2026.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Different DLL3 modality, dosing, eligibility and response-assessment maturity; the MP0712 side of the comparison contains no therapeutic outcome data.

competitor_comparisons.competitor: Obrixtamig in DLL3-positive large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: Heavily pretreated DLL3-positive large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma in a Phase 1 dose-escalation study.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: At doses of at least 90 micrograms per kilogram, obrixtamig reported a 70% objective response rate among 10 LCNEC patients, with a 44.4% confirmed response rate in later step-up cohorts. MP0712 disclosed no therapeutic cohort result at ASCO2026.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Very small competitor subgroup, different modality and dose, and no MP0712 therapeutic outcome dataset at this event.

target_assessments.data_quality: Low for therapeutic interpretation: the event confirmed study activation and design but contained no Phase 1/2a therapeutic efficacy, safety, dosimetry or follow-up denominator.
target_assessments.clinical_interpretation: The protocol presentation and separate diagnostic uptake observation support continued development but do not justify changing SCLC assumptions before therapeutic cohort data are available.

outcomes.rationale: Study activation and tumor uptake are directionally supportive, but they are insufficient therapeutic evidence for a material revision.
No therapeutic efficacy or safety result was disclosed, so the pre-event clinical assumptions should remain unchanged.
A small downside branch reflects execution and translation uncertainty, not a disclosed negative clinical result.
The study was actively recruiting and dosing, with no disclosed reason to suspend development.

target_assessments.data_quality: Low: the trial-in-progress disclosure provided no EP-NEC therapeutic cohort size, response, safety or follow-up result.
target_assessments.clinical_interpretation: The event established inclusion of DLL3-expressing neuroendocrine tumors but did not test clinical efficacy against the emerging competitor benchmark.

outcomes.rationale: Specific diagnostic uptake and ongoing dosing are supportive but not therapeutic proof.
No therapeutic EP-NEC result was disclosed, so assumptions remain unchanged.
A small uncertainty branch remains because translation into treatment activity is untested.
Active enrollment and the absence of a negative clinical finding do not support suspension.

target_assessments.data_quality: Low: no LCNEC therapeutic denominator, efficacy, safety, dosimetry or follow-up result was reported.
target_assessments.clinical_interpretation: LCNEC remains biologically relevant for DLL3 targeting, but the event did not supply evidence to change assumptions relative to an early but high competitor response benchmark.

outcomes.rationale: The study rationale and diagnostic uptake are supportive but not sufficient for a therapeutic revision.
No LCNEC therapeutic result was disclosed, making no change the clinically appropriate base interpretation.
A small downside branch reflects uncertain translation and a demanding early competitor benchmark.
No safety or development finding at the event suggested suspension.
